ev.q: Postarrival SARS-CoV-2 pooled testing data from CDC’s Traveler-based Genomic Surveillance program
participants completed a standardized survey that included questions regarding demographic characteristics, flight country of origin, and whether predeparture testing had occurred

changes.why: The participant questionnaire is a standardized self-administered survey of volunteers, which is 'other survey', not chart abstraction or a field interview; it supplies the predeparture-testing percentages.

equity.level_reason: Age and sex are described only as similar across periods, and U.S. residency is a traveler descriptor not framed as a social position. No disparity is reported.

level_alternative.reason: U.S. residency differs between periods and could be read as a nativity or migration-status descriptor, which would make the level 1.

ev.q: Participants during each period were similar in age and gender
Participants during each period were similar in age and gender

equity.equity_measurement: Demographics are reported only as similar across periods (supplement); U.S. residency is the one difference noted and is not analysed further.
